name: @oscharko-dev/keiko-git
description: Internal workspace package: shared Git core primitives — hardened process runner and environments, repository resolution and path containment, porcelain/ref/remote/history parsers, and failure classification. Currently consumed by keiko-server; keiko-tools imports only the remote-failure classification (ADR-0115 Non-goals sanctions its own governed spawn surface) and keiko-workspace stays spawn-free by design. Not published independently.
